turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:

I even turned down a training workshop I was supposed to run recently because it was in a high-rise. And... I just can't bring myself to get in one, so I figured I should probably come talk to someone about it.
